preconditions.description: The input must be a string representing the sequence of sounds made by the kookaburras.

preconditions.expression: all(char in 'Ha ha' for char in sound_sequence)
preconditions.description: The string must contain only 'H', 'h', 'a', and ' ' characters, representing the sounds of the kookaburras.
The input string must not be empty.

postconditions.description: The function must return a non-negative integer representing the number of kookaburras.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 0 or (return_value % 2 == 0 and sound_sequence[0] == 'H') or (return_value % 2 == 1 and sound_sequence[0] == 'h')
postconditions.description: The number of kookaburras is determined by the alternating pattern of 'Ha' and 'ha'. The first kookaburra's sound determines the count.
